uniqueAngle.existingConsensus: Lost-deal reviews are CRM hygiene: pick a loss reason from the dropdown and move on.
uniqueAngle.keelClaim: The dropdown hides the lesson — a real post-mortem interrogates what you knew and when, and most losses were visible earlier than anyone admits.
uniqueAngle.supportingReason: Loss reasons chosen for reporting convenience erase the pattern a rep could actually learn from.
